deploybot: :rotating_light: Deploy starting: tagged release `v2026.03b-hotfix1` -> prod (canary eu-west -> rollouts). commit: `abcdef1234cafe`
deploybot: Change window: 2026-03-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2026.03b-hotfix1
jamie: copying notes — which services are in this roll?
deploybot: services: embedder-v2, tokenizer-fix, routing-proxy. canary targets: eu-west-1 (5% traffic), then eu-central, us-west, us-east
liam: seeing a spike in p95 for embedder-v2 on eu-west canary after ~3m, +220ms. digging logs now
sara: can you drop the canary back to 0 while we triage? recommend pinning eu-west to previous tag if unstable :pushpin:
oncall-sre: threshold is p95 > 150ms for 3 consecutive minutes => auto-rollback signal. We're at 3m and trending. advise manual pin to avoid global rollback
jamie: ok let's hold global promote. @deploybot can you pin eu-west to `v2026.03a` and keep other regions on rollout hold?
deploybot: Applying pin...
```
Pin command: deployctl pin --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --service=embedder-v2 --tag=v2026.03a --reason="canary latency regression"
```
deploybot: :pushpin: Pin applied: embedder-v2 pinned to `v2026.03a` in eu-west-1 (operator: jamie)
liam: logs show a malloc churn on the new binary in eu-west nodes, possibly due to different instance type. opening infra ticket #INF-778
sara: thanks. once infra confirms, we'll decide whether to re-run with different instance or promote rest of regions
release-bot: Release notes snippet posted to the docs page. Attn: PMs — change affects embeddings latency; suggested rollback FAQ updated
deploybot: Canary check: tokenizer-fix GOOD, routing-proxy GOOD, embedder-v2 PINNED in eu-west-1. Rolling promotion to remaining regions paused. :white_check_mark:
liam: attaching quick metric dump:
```
service: embedder-v2 | region: eu-west-1
before(tag v2026.03a) p95=120ms
after(tag v2026.03b-hotfix1) p95=342ms
errors: +0.2% (retries)
```
jamie: ack. I'll coordinate with infra to test a build with different allocator and re-run canary tomorrow in same window
oncall-sre: leaving monitor alert at high sensitivity until we confirm. ping me if you need a regional rollback across more services
release-bot: tagging internal changelog: "hotfix: backported tokenizer safety and embedder mem-fix pending infra validation"
jamie: closing the thread for now — global promote paused, eu-west pinned. follow-ups in #incidents if it escalates. :lock:
